name: UTM
title: UTM: free Parallels alternative
hook: Parallels charges you a hundred bucks a year to run Windows on your Mac. This app does it for free.
job: Runs Windows and Linux on Mac

features.intro: It turns your Mac into a Windows PC.
features.say: Windows eleven, Ubuntu and Linux, even classic old systems.
Every virtual machine sits in one simple list. Press play, and it boots.
It runs at near native speed on Apple Silicon.

caption:
Parallels charges $99.99/year to run Windows on your Mac. UTM does it for free 💻

✅ Runs Windows 11, Ubuntu, Linux and even classic old systems
✅ Every virtual machine in one simple list, one click to start
✅ Near native speed on Apple Silicon
✅ No subscription, no trial timer, 100% free

💻 Mac
ℹ️ Windows itself isn't included: you bring your own Windows license (the paid App Store version of UTM is the same app as the free download)

Comment "WINDOWS" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

Follow @itsongit for a new free open-source find every day
